incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: HIGH - Auth service - token validation errors spiking (PD-INC-1287) Link: https://redwood.pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-INC-1287

pagerduty-bot: Incident triggered: auth-service -> assigned to on-call (Mia). Escalation policy: Auth SRE.

Mia (eng-oncall): ack'd. I'm taking first pass. Anyone else seeing downstream 401 churn in frontend metrics?

Kevin (support): yep, support dashboard shows a jump in customer 401s ~ 10:12 UTC, multiple customers reporting login failures.

Sam (eng-sre): pulling logs from auth-ingest. Seeing a flood of `signature verification failed` from the JWT verifier. Error: `kid not found in JWKS`.

Arjun (eng): that sounds like JWKS rotation mismatch. Did we deploy a new signing key earlier?

Mia (eng-oncall): not in last hour per deploy bot. ops-bot, when was the last key rotation event?

ops-bot: last_key_rotation: 1776920000 (2026-03-13T02:00:00Z). manual_rotate_flag: false. JWKS cache TTL: 15m.

Sam (eng-sre): trace shows clients sending JWTs with `kid: key-v2026-03-13b` but the JWKS endpoint currently returns only `key-v2026-03-12a`. Cache hasn't refreshed.

Mia (eng-oncall): ok likely stale JWKS in cache or a broken propagation to the public JWKS. Can someone curl the JWKS endpoint from public edge?

Arjun (eng): running from my laptop: `curl -s https://auth.redwood.ai/.well-known/jwks.json | jq '.keys[].kid'` returns only "key-v2026-03-12a".

Sam (eng-sre): checking the auth-service pods internal cache: `kubectl exec -n prod deploy/auth -- curl -s http://localhost:8080/admin/jwks-cache` -> shows cached_at 1777006800, ttl 900, source: s3://auth-keys/manifest.json (version: 2026-03-12).

Mia (eng-oncall): so the signing key rotation finished upstream but the manifest didn't publish? or the S3 sync failed. Kevin, can you surface impacted customers? We need impact estimate.

Kevin (support): fast look: ~47 distinct orgs hit 5xx/401s in last 12m, top 5 tenants: Acme, NovaPay, BrightDesk, Clio+, Zephyr Labs. I filed a priority support note to the top 3.

Lisa (product): flagging that NovaPay is on a live demo in EMEA, they just messaged customer success. We should prioritize a temporary mitigation.

Sam (eng-sre): mitigation options: 1) force JWKS cache refresh across auth pods 2) publish the missing manifest to S3 from key-store backup 3) enable legacy verification mode (accept both keys) for 15m 4) rollback to prior signer (not ideal).

Mia (eng-oncall): let's 1) force cache refresh immediately, 2) if that fails, enable legacy multi-key acceptance. Who can push the refresh?

Arjun (eng): I can push a cache refresh endpoint. Running: `kubectl exec -n prod deploy/auth -- curl -XPOST http://localhost:8080/admin/refresh-jwks`

ops-bot: POST /admin/refresh-jwks -> 202 Accepted -> tasks enqueued (pods: 6).

Sam (eng-sre): logs show each pod refreshed and fetched manifest version 2026-03-13 in s3 now. JWT verification errors dropping. 401 rate back to baseline. Metrics: 5xx auth down from 320/min -> 12/min within 90s.

Mia (eng-oncall): paging back to PagerDuty: please ack resolution tentative, monitoring for 20m. Mia -> setting watch.

pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-INC-1287 status: acknowledged by Mia. On-call follow-up: monitor.

Kevin (support): I'm telling top-3 customers we're seeing partial recovery and monitoring.

Sam (eng-sre): one anomaly: one region edge still returns old JWKS for a subset of CDN nodes. Working with infra to purge CDN cache of `/.well-known/jwks.json`.

Arjun (eng): running CDN purge: `curl -XPOST https://cdn-api.redwood.ai/purge -d '{"paths":["/.well-known/jwks.json"]}'` -> purge accepted, edge caches invalidated.

Mia (eng-oncall): good. Monitoring latency and error budgets. Any sign of token replay or security concerns?

Sam (eng-sre): no sign of token replay. This is an availability/regeneration propagation issue. No signs of signature key compromise.

Mia (eng-oncall): OK. I'll prepare a short incident summary for customer comms and postmortem. Arjun, can you capture exact root cause and remediation steps in the incident ticket? Sam, capture metrics and timeline.

Arjun (eng): will do. Root cause draft: failed S3 publish of rotated jwks manifest due to transient permission error during key rotation job; cache TTL allowed old manifest to persist; missing key caused `kid` mismatch. Immediate remediation: forced JWKS refresh across auth pods + CDN purge. Follow-ups: add health-check for manifest publish, reduce JWKS TTL from 15m to 1m for faster rotation, add canary propagation check, add automated rollback for pub failure.

pagerduty-bot: PD-INC-1287 -> status: resolved by Mia at 1777008950 (tentative).

Mia (eng-oncall): resolving here too. Closing notes: no evidence of token compromise, affected customers contacted, follow-up postmortem scheduled 2pm UTC tomorrow. Assign: Arjun (root cause), Sam (metrics), Kevin (customer comms).

Lisa (product): thanks all. Please ping me the postmortem link once ready.

incident-bot: reminder: create postmortem draft and include timeline, mitigation, and action items.

Mia (eng-oncall): thanks team. Handoff: Arjun will take postmortem and notifications. I'm back to on-call standby. :white_check_mark:
